title: Canadian Armed Forces members among NATO troops pulled out of Iraq
desc: Canadian military members and civilians are among the personnel NATO has pulled out of Iraq as the country faces retaliatory attacks from Iran along with other Gulf countries during the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

title: The worst heat wave to hit Southern California in March is finally coming to an end
desc: Temperatures are expected to finally begin to drop over the weekend, with forecasters saying it will be in the upper 70s and low 80s along the coast and the low 90s inland and in the valleys.

title: Pentagon policy limiting independent press access is unlawful, judge rules
desc: A federal judge on Friday voided various parts of a restrictive press policy rolled out by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth last year, ruling that they trampled on the constitutional rights of reporters who seek to cover the US military from within its sprawling headquarters.

title: Gold tumbles nearly 10% this week in worst performance in nearly 15 years
desc: Gold futures fell for the seventh time in eight sessions, concluding a week that saw the metal's largest-ever single-week dollar decline and the biggest percentage slide in nearly 15 years.

title: Gerry Adams says civil case ‘verged on show trial’ and ‘should never have been brought’
desc: Former Sinn Féin leader says he attended trial ‘out of respect’ for complainants injured in IRA bombings

title: Anthony, Jackson nail US double at world indoors
desc: Jordan Anthony was crowned sprint king at the world indoor championships on Friday as shot putter Chase Jackson ensured a double golden start for the US team in Torun, Poland.

title: Tánaiste hints at excise duty cut next week to help alleviate rising fuel costs
desc: Simon Harris told RTÉ News that cutting excise can be done quickly and passed on quickly.

title: Trump weighing several options for U.S. troops inside Iran
desc: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump is weighing whether to send possibly thousands of U.S. troops into Iran as he looks for a way to achieve some of his key goals and end the war, according to the two current U.S. officials, two former U.S. officials and another person familiar with the discussions

title: Alisson out again as Liverpool suffer fresh injury blow ahead of Brighton clash
desc: Liverpool face a significant blow to their top-four pursuit as goalkeeper Alisson Becker has been ruled out of the Brighton clash and Brazil's upcoming friendlies due to a sudden injury.

title: Aurigny flights cancelled due to pilot absences
desc: Affected services are between Alderney and Guernsey, as well as between Alderney and Southampton.
